# fractional rectangle

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:selectorTypeFractionalRectangle`](gmeow-selectorTypeFractionalRectangle.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/selectorTypeFractionalRectangle>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/images`](../../slices/images.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A fractional-coordinate rectangle (x, y, width, height) in [0.0, 1.0] relative to image dimensions.
